title: Using DeepSpeed and Megatron to Train Megatron-Turing NLG 530B, A Large-Scale Generative Language Model
reasoning: The paper dedicates a significant portion of its social bias analysis (Section 5) to investigating how the model represents and responds to religious identifiers. Table 10 and the 'Religion Analysis' subsection specifically evaluate associations and sentiment regarding six religious and non-religious belief systems (Atheism, Buddhism, Christianity, Hinduism, Islam, Judaism).
